mechanism: A gap-filler used when {{datum}} is missing; treated as true temporarily to allow thinking to proceed. Must be tracked and validated.
invariants: Provisionality: must be explicitly flagged as unverified.
Tracking: must name what it stands in for — a missing {{datum}}, or a judgment not made.
Discharge: must carry a validation deadline or an invalidation trigger.

premise.description: The statement treated as temporarily true

failure_modes: Calcified: depended on far downstream from where it was made, with nothing prompting a re-check.
Mutually inconsistent set: two assumptions each close a local gap and contradict each other in the same chain.
Judgment recorded as datum-gap: the premise replaces a decision nobody made rather than a fact nobody has, so validating it has no target.
